svg.aria-label: Projects from the 42 Common Core: webserv (NGINX-like HTTP/1.1 server in C++98: non-blocking I/O with poll(), CGI, uploads); minishell (Bash-like Unix shell with pipes, redirections, env vars and signals); ft_transcendence (Real-time multiplayer Pong website, built and delivered as a team); Inception (Multi-container infrastructure: NGINX (TLS), WordPress and MariaDB); Born2beroot (Hardened Linux server in a VM: encrypted LVM, UFW, SSH, sudo policy); Philosophers (Dining philosophers simulation without data races or deadlocks); cub3D (Wolfenstein-style 3D game engine rendered with raycasting); +8 more (Libft · ft_printf · get_next_line · push_swap pipex · so_long · NetPractice · CPP 00–09)
